_comment: Picture fields that have no 'alt' + 'decorative' pair next to them, each with the reason. check-cms refuses any other picture field without a description (see scripts/README.md, 'Picture descriptions'). Path syntax is the same as wiring-ignore.json; an entry that exempts nothing is an error. This is only for pictures that are never shown to a visitor as a picture - not a way to skip writing alt text for a photo.

entries.reason: The social-share / search-engine picture lives in tags, not in the page: it is never drawn as an , so there is nothing for a screen reader to describe.
A page's own social-share picture lives in tags, never as an . Its optional description (shareImageAlt) is printed as og:image:alt, checked by check-seo.

The UK map backdrop sits inside the map graphic, which is described as a whole by the 'Map description (for screen readers)' field (svgAriaLabel); the picture itself is an SVG <image> inside that described graphic.
Cover frame of the concept film: it is the video's poster attribute, not an . The film is described by its own 'Description for screen readers' field (model.video.label).
Cover frame of the closing-banner animation: it is the video's poster attribute, not an . The video carries its own accessible label (the section's videoLabel).
